DOCTORAL PROGRAMS
Ready to make a real impact with your research? If you’re passionate about collaborative, ethical research that tackles important issues, a Ph.D. might be the perfect next step. UNC Charlotte offers Ph.D. studies in:
Bioinformatics and Computational Biology, Ph.D.
Computing and Information Systems, Ph.D.
Data Science, Ph.D.
